text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text:
Oh, are you interested in this beauty serum?
Ah, I hear that even young boys these days care about skincare.
But this is expensive, so I won't give it to you♪ Here, settle for this instead.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん、
この美容液に興味あるの？
あー
最近の若者は、
男の子も美容に気を使うらしいもんね。
でも
これは高いからあげないよ♪　
ほら、
これで我慢しときー
